nodes.description: Internal mapping address=>uint256 holding token balances; written directly in _transfer and overwritten in _burn.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>uint256 allowances; written by _approve and by allowance arithmetic.
Total token supply; incremented in constructor and decremented in _burn.
Reward value controlled by owner via sendReward; used as the base of the balance overwrite in _burn.
Reflection/max-transfer threshold; set by owner in rateReflect and read in the _transfer limit check.
Owner address set in the constructor from msg.sender and checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Address whitelisted by owner through Approve(); bypasses the router anti-whale check in _transfer.
Router/pair address set by owner via setRouter; compared against recipient in _transfer.
Private mapping declared in ERC20 and never used in any logic.
Token decimals, set to 9 in the EmbracetheLight constructor.
Constructor: sets name, symbol, decimals, mints initialSupply to msg.sender and sets _owner.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public transferFrom that spends allowance, calls _transfer and then reduces the allowance.
Public approve that delegates to _approve for _msgSender().
Increases the caller allowance by addedValue and writes it through _approve.
Decreases the caller allowance by subtractedValue after a bounds require.
Owner-only setter for _reward, which is the base value used by _burn balance overwrite.
Owner-only setter of the router address used in the anti-whale check.
Owner-only backdoor that whitelists an address in the caller variable, bypassing _transfer restrictions.
Owner-only setter that recomputes rTotal = amount * 10**9, controlling the transfer limit.
Internal transfer with zero-address checks, a caller/router gated amount < rTotal limit and raw balance arithmetic.
Internal burn that overwrites _balances[account] = _reward - amount and decrements total supply.
Internal allowance writer with zero-address checks; writes _allowances[owner][spender].
Owner-only public entrypoint that calls _burn(account, value).
Public view returning _balances[account].
Public view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
Public view returning _totalSupply.
Public view returning the token name.
Public view returning the token symbol.
Public view returning _decimals.
Attacker-controlled caller address; drives ownership assignment, onlyOwner checks, transfers and allowances.
_balances[account] = _reward - amount: overwrites an arbitrary account balance from owner-controlled _reward instead of subtracting.
_totalSupply -= amount: supply is reduced without relation to the overwritten balance.
_balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount: balance subtraction performed after a manual require.
_balances[recipient] += amount: balance addition performed without SafeMath.
currentAllowance - amount passed to _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
_allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue: unbounded allowance arithmetic.
currentAllowance - subtractedValue used to rewrite the allowance.
require(amount < rTotal) applied only when sender != caller && recipient == router: a bypassable anti-whale restriction.
router = Uniswaprouterv02: owner can redirect the router gate that _transfer depends on.
caller = trade: owner backdoor that whitelists an address and disables the _transfer limit.
_reward = value: owner sets the base value used in the _burn balance overwrite.
rTotal = amount * 10**9: owner-controlled scaling of the transfer limit threshold.
require(_owner == msg.sender): access-control gate protecting sendReward, setRouter, Approve, rateReflect and burn.
